operations.title: List avatars
operations.description: List avatars for the authenticated user with cursor-based pagination.

operations.title: Create avatar
operations.description: Create a new avatar with a reference image and voice.

personality.example: You are a helpful support agent assisting users with their account questions. Be friendly, patient, and provide clear step-by-step guidance.

startScript.example: Hello! How can I help you today?

operations.title: List conversations
operations.description: List realtime avatar conversations for the authenticated user with cursor-based pagination. Each conversation corresponds to a realtime session, and the conversation ID matches the realtime session ID. Pass `avatar` to restrict results to a single avatar.

operations.title: Get avatar usage
operations.description: Get aggregate usage statistics for avatar conversations, including total duration, session counts, average duration, and a per-day breakdown. Per-day buckets are keyed by UTC calendar date. The date range must not exceed 90 days.

operations.title: Get conversation
operations.description: Get detailed information about a specific conversation, including the transcript and recording download URL when available. The conversation ID is the same value returned when the realtime session was created.

operations.title: Delete conversation
operations.description: Delete a conversation and its associated data.

operations.title: Get avatar
operations.description: Get details of a specific avatar.

operations.title: Update avatar
operations.description: Update an existing avatar. At least one field must be provided.

personality.example: You are a helpful support agent assisting users with their account questions. Be friendly, patient, and provide clear step-by-step guidance.

startScript.example: Hello! How can I help you today?

operations.title: Delete avatar
operations.description: Delete an avatar.

operations.title: Generate avatar video from audio or text
operations.description: Start an asynchronous task to generate a video of an avatar speaking. Provide `speech` with `type: "audio"` (audio file) or `type: "text"` (text script for TTS). Poll `GET /v1/tasks/:id` to check progress and retrieve the output video URL once complete.

operations.title: Create document
operations.description: Create a new knowledge document. Documents can be attached to avatars to provide additional context during conversations.

content.example:
# Product FAQ

## What is your return policy?

We offer a 30-day return policy...

operations.title: List documents
operations.description: List knowledge documents for the authenticated user with cursor-based pagination.

operations.title: Get document
operations.description: Get details of a specific knowledge document.

operations.title: Update document
operations.description: Update a knowledge document. At least one of `name` or `content` must be provided.

operations.title: Delete document
operations.description: Delete a knowledge document. This also removes it from all avatars it was attached to.

operations.title: Create realtime session
operations.description: Create a new realtime session with the specified model configuration. The returned ID is also the conversation ID used later to fetch transcripts and recordings from the avatar conversation endpoints.

operations.title: Get realtime session
operations.description: Get the status of a realtime session. This endpoint uses the same ID that the avatar conversation endpoints later expose as the conversation ID.

operations.title: Cancel realtime session
operations.description: Cancel an active realtime session.

operations.title: Get task detail
operations.description: Return details about a task. Consumers of this API should not expect updates more frequent than once every five seconds for a given task.

operations.title: Cancel or delete a task
operations.description:
Tasks that are running, pending, or throttled can be canceled by invoking this method. Invoking this method for other tasks will delete them.

The output data associated with a deleted task will be deleted from persistent storage in accordance with our data retention policy. Aborted and deleted tasks will not be able to be fetched again in the future.

operations.title: Image to video
operations.description: This endpoint will start a new task to generate a video from an image.

operations.title: Text to video
operations.description: This endpoint will start a new task to generate a video from a text prompt.

operations.title: Video to video
operations.description: This endpoint will start a new task to generate a video from a video.

operations.title: Text/Image to Image
operations.description: This endpoint will start a new task to generate images from text and/or image(s)

operations.title: Image upscale
operations.description: Upscale an image with Magnific precision upscaling. Each input dimension must be between 300px and 8000px. Output width and height are the input dimensions multiplied by `scaleFactor` (default 2). Output width times height cannot exceed 25,300,000 pixels (~25.3 million).

operations.title: Video upscale
operations.description: This endpoint starts a task to upscale a video. Set `model` to choose the upscaler.

operations.title: Video to HDR
operations.description: This endpoint starts a task to upconvert an SDR video to true HDR with Ruby, Runway's HDR grading model. The output keeps the source's own pixels — luma and color are extended into the HDR range, nothing is re-synthesized. Set `outputFormat` to choose the delivery profile: `hdr10` (HEVC Main 10, BT.2020 + PQ, the default), `hlg` (HEVC Main 10, BT.2020 + HLG), `hdr_prores` (BT.2020 + PQ ProRes .mov

operations.title: Control a character
operations.description: This endpoint will start a new task to control a character's facial expressions and body movements using a reference video.
operations.verification: Live task failed; diagnose before retry

operations.title: Generate sound effects
operations.description: This endpoint will start a new task to generate sound effects from a text description.

operations.title: Speech to speech
operations.description: This endpoint will start a new task to convert speech from one voice to another in audio or video.

operations.title: Text to speech
operations.description: This endpoint will start a new task to generate speech from text.

operations.title: Voice dubbing
operations.description: This endpoint will start a new task to dub audio content to a target language.

operations.title: Voice isolation
operations.description: This endpoint will start a new task to isolate the voice from the background audio. Audio duration must be greater than 4.6 seconds and less than 3600 seconds.

operations.title: Routed video generation
operations.description: Start a video generation task using a saved Model Router config instead of naming a model.

operations.title: Routed image generation
operations.description: Start an image generation task using a saved Model Router config instead of naming a model.

operations.title: Routed audio generation
operations.description: Start an audio generation task using a saved Model Router config instead of naming a model. Set input.type to speech to speak promptText verbatim, or audio to generate audio described by promptText.

operations.title: List linked workspace usage
operations.description: List per-generation credit-usage rows for the linked Runway workspaces you administer, newest first. Unlike `/v1/organization/usage` (this API project's own usage), this reports usage from the workspace linked to this API project. Authorized via that account link.

operations.title: List linked workspace audit logs
operations.description: List audit log entries for the linked Runway workspaces you administer, newest first. Authorized via the account link between this API project and the workspace.

operations.title: Get a linked workspace audit log entry
operations.description: Get a single audit log entry, including its metadata and forensic details, for a linked Runway workspace you administer. Authorized via the account link between this API project and the workspace.

operations.title: Get organization information
operations.description: Get usage tier and credit balance information about the organization associated with the API key used to make the request.

operations.title: Query credit usage
operations.description: Fetch credit usage data broken down by model and day for the organization associated with the API key used to make the request. Up to 90 days of data can be queried at a time.

operations.title: Upload a file
operations.description: Uploads a temporary media file that can be referenced in API generation requests. The uploaded files will be automatically expired and deleted after a period of time. It is strongly recommended to use our SDKs for this which have a simplified interface that directly accepts file objects.

operations.title: Localize an ad image
operations.description: Localize an existing ad image for a target language, preserving visual creative while adapting on-screen messaging.

operations.title: Create a marketing stock image
operations.description: Generate a polished marketing stock image from a text brief and optional brand logo image.

operations.title: Create a product ad video
operations.description: Generate a cinematic product ad from product images, optional style references, product info, and creative direction.

operations.title: Create product campaign images
operations.description: Generate four fashion campaign images from a product image and style brief.

operations.title: Swap a product in a reference video
operations.description: Replace the product in a reference video with a new product, preserving camera motion, lighting, and scene composition.

operations.title: Create a multi-shot video
operations.description: Generate a multi-cut video from a story prompt (auto mode) or a custom shot list (custom mode).

operations.title: Create a product UGC video
operations.description: Generate a vertical user-generated content ad from a character image, product image, product details, and optional creative direction.

operations.title: List Model Routers
operations.description: List Model Router configurations for the authenticated organization with cursor-based pagination.

operations.title: Create Model Router
operations.description: Create a Model Router configuration.

operations.title: Retrieve Model Router
operations.description: Retrieve a Model Router configuration by ID.

operations.title: Update Model Router
operations.description: Update a Model Router configuration. Settings changes append a new version; name and description updates do not. Settings are merged with the current snapshot - omitted fields keep their existing values.

operations.title: Delete Model Router
operations.description: Delete a Model Router configuration. Deleted Model Routers cannot be used for generation.

operations.title: List Model Router requests
operations.description: Paginated routing history for live Model Router requests (successful routes and failures). Playground dry runs are not recorded.

operations.title: List voices
operations.description: List custom voices for the authenticated organization with cursor-based pagination.

operations.title: Create a voice
operations.description: Create a custom voice from a text description, or clone a voice from an audio sample.

operations.title: Get a voice
operations.description: Get details about a specific custom voice.

operations.title: Update a voice
operations.description: Update the name and/or description of a custom voice.

operations.title: Delete a voice
operations.description: Delete a custom voice.

operations.title: Preview a voice
operations.description: Generate a short audio preview of a voice from a text description. Use this to audition a voice before creating it.

operations.title: Run a published workflow
operations.description: Start a new task to execute a published workflow. You can optionally provide custom input values via `nodeOutputs` to override the defaults defined in the workflow graph.

operations.title: Get workflow details
operations.description: Returns details about a specific published workflow, including its graph schema.

operations.title: List published workflows
operations.description: Returns a list of all published workflows for the authenticated user, grouped by source workflow with their published versions.

operations.title: Get workflow invocation detail
operations.description: Return details about a workflow invocation. Consumers of this API should not expect updates more frequent than once every five seconds for a given workflow invocation. A `SUCCEEDED` invocation may still have had individual nodes fail, so check `nodeErrors` to detect a partial run rather than relying on `status` alone.
